_comment: Singapore — Trade Classification, Customs and Excise Duties (STCCED), 2022 edition, the current one. Singapore publishes NO machine-readable schedule: the only source is a 655-page PDF (https://file.go.gov.sg/stcced2022.pdf) linked from customs.gov.sg. So there is no acquire adapter and no scheduled refresh — the PDF is fetched by hand into data/sg_tariff_source/ and scripts/hts_automation/parse_sg_stcced.py converts it, emitting both the tariff CSV this spec consumes and the legal-notes corpus under data/hts_notes/sg_2022/. The edition is annual at most and has no revision numbering, so revision_id_pattern is the bare year. Codes are 8-digit; hierarchy is the dash depth the book prints.
_comment_verify: No verify thresholds: those compare a new revision against its predecessor, and there is only one edition. Add them when a second edition lands.
